implementation: Own bounded read-only C# parser; format facts consulted, no upstream program source bundled.
findings: CPK/TOC packet byte count is little-endian uint64 after its 8-byte tag/flags prefix.
UTF schema and cells use big-endian widths; version and row-offset share the 0x08..0x0b header word.
Constant/zero/per-row storage differ; column defaults live in schema, not in each row.
Named TOC payload offsets use the minimum of content and TOC bases for the inspected format convention.
CRI table masking uses a documented rolling XOR; it is not a game license or DRM bypass.
Stored compressed payload is preserved, not guessed or decompressed.
